concerns.text: FR-005 (Lagged Alignment) and US2 require alignment of MMN to subsequent accuracy blocks. Tasks T021 (Behavioral Binning), T022 (Lagged Alignment), T022b (Learning Phase), and T024 (Finalize Aligned Dataset) are marked as unchecked [ ]. Without these tasks being executable, the primary data artifact `data/aligned_data.csv` cannot be generated, blocking US3 (T027) and the entire statistical modeling phase.

FR-006 (Statistical Modeling) and US3 require fitting a Gaussian LME. Task T027 is marked as unchecked [ ] and explicitly depends on `data/aligned_data.csv` from T024. Since T024 is incomplete, T027 cannot be implemented, leaving the core hypothesis test unaddressed.

FR-005 and US2 explicitly mandate the exclusion of 'underpowered' subjects (Constitution VII). While T016 flags exclusion, the actual filtering of these subjects from the final aligned dataset is assigned to T024, which is unchecked. The pipeline lacks a completed task to enforce this exclusion in the final input for the LME model.

FR-005 requires 'Lagged Alignment' with a 50-trial source window. Task T022 describes this logic but is unchecked [ ]. Task T040 (Lagged Window Sanity Check) is also unchecked. The implementation of the core alignment logic is missing from the completed task list.

FR-005 and US2 require the output `data/aligned_data.csv` to contain time-series of MMN and accuracy. Task T024 is the sole task responsible for generating this file, yet it is marked unchecked [ ]. No other task produces this critical artifact.

FR-006 requires a 'Learning_Phase' predictor for the LME model. Task T022b is responsible for generating this feature but is marked unchecked [ ]. Without this task, the model formula `MMN_Amplitude ~ Accuracy + Learning_Phase` cannot be executed.

FR-005 requires handling missing behavioral logs via 'Stimulus-Driven' fallback. While T003 handles mode selection, the downstream tasks (T021-T024) do not explicitly describe the logic for generating the aligned dataset in 'Stimulus-Driven' mode (where accuracy is missing). The unchecked status of T024 suggests this fallback path is not implemented.

FR-007 requires a permutation test to validate significance. Task T029 is marked as unchecked [ ]. While T041 is checked, it only reports stability; the actual implementation of the permutation test logic (T029) is missing.

FR-005 and US2 require the exclusion of underpowered subjects from the primary GLMM input. Task T016 flags them, but T024 (which merges and filters data) is unchecked. The pipeline lacks a completed task to ensure the final `aligned_data.csv` does not contain excluded subjects.

FR-005 requires 'Lagged Alignment' where MMN (t-N to t-M) aligns to accuracy (t to t+n). Task T022 is unchecked. The logic for calculating the lagged window and aligning it to the subsequent block is not implemented.
